$comment: Root ADR-0280 (ownership), ADR-0281 (collected openly, politely, stopping when refused) and ADR-0283 (the User-Agent names us; a contact is optional). How 법원경매정보 (courtauction.go.kr) is asked, how slowly, when, and what makes a run stop. The collector (`collect-courtauction-go-kr` in services/foundation-outbox-publisher), the Silver load (infra/lakehouse/spark/jobs/courtauction_go_kr.py) and their tests read this file; nothing else restates these values. Checked 2026-10-19: no robots.txt (404); the list searches answer JSON to a plain POST with no session; one condition listed 17,863 items.

manners.$comment: ADR-0281 §1-§5. request_spacing_seconds is a floor a setting may only raise; a robots.txt Crawl-delay above it raises it too. One connection, no concurrency. A run starts only inside the quiet hours (KST) and sends no request after they end. max_requests_per_run bounds one night: since root ADR-0290 §1 asks the item search with a ±365-day window it lists about 108,306 rows (2026-10-21), 2,167 pages of 50, plus about 251 sale-result pages and robots.txt (2026-10-19 night) = about 2,420 requests; 3,500 keeps a complete pass with 45% room and, at the measured 3.4 s a request (78 minutes for 1,377), ends within about 200 minutes, inside the 300-minute window. Retries are for network errors only, never for a refusal.

refusal.$comment: ADR-0281 §3. Any of these ends the run at once as `refused` and blocks later runs until a person removes the state file the collector writes. An HTML body where JSON belongs (a login, notice, block or CAPTCHA page) and the site's own ipcheck=false are refusals too.

forbidden_in_collector.$comment: ADR-0281 §4. The collector's source must not contain these (a test reads it): no proxy, no rotation, no browser disguise, no CAPTCHA, no randomness in timing or identity.

item_search.$comment: 물건 검색 (진행 물건). cortAuctnSrchCondCd 0004601/0004602 and lclDspslGdsLstUsgCd 10000/20000 are the four combinations the site's own search form sends; the codes are stored as given, their meanings are not restated here. A pass is complete only when every combination was read to its last page.

date_window.$comment: Root ADR-0290 §1-§2. Every item-search request carries this bid-date range, fixed for the whole run from its KST start date. Without it the server answers a default range that slides a day every day (2026-10-21: the four conditions held 63,005 rows without dates and 108,306 with this range), so items whose sale date lies past the default look as if they left the list. The Silver load counts a pass as complete only when its requests carried both fields.

sale_result_search.$comment: 매각결과 검색: the same row shape for items whose sale date has passed, with the sale amount.

collection.$comment: Root ADR-0289/0290 values the collection rules read (collection-domain::court_auction). The transport, the queue and Bronze stay outside; these are only what the rules need. Separate from the ADR-0281 manners/refusal/forbidden_in_collector above, which the current collector still reads until it is replaced.

block_signals.$comment: ADR-0289 §3. A block is HTTP 200 with data.ipcheck=false, a redirect, or HTML where JSON belongs; a good answer has status=200 and an object at /data. Checked before any failure so a blocked session is not read as a broken request.

change_fields.$comment: ADR-0290 §2. The list-row fields whose change means a case's detail should be re-read; fields outside this set do not count. Validated against real rows when the detail lane lands; this is the state a list row carries.

pace.$comment: ADR-0289 §4. Per endpoint group, the AIMD width: start/min/max requests in flight, widen after increase_after clear and timely answers, divide by decrease_divisor on a block or a response slower than slow_response_millis. Starts from the 2026-10-21 spike (item search is serial on the server; case detail took concurrency; goods detail is photo-heavy).

recrawl.$comment: ADR-0290 §3. A case's detail is due when never read, when its watched row fields changed, on the days around its sale date, or after max_age_days (a backstop). closed_status_codes are the 종국 jinstatCd values; left empty until measured, so until then the backstop and row-change drive re-reads (never under-reads).

pnu_assembly.$comment: ADR-0290 §8. The 19-digit PNU from the goods-detail object: legal-dong code (4 fields) + ledger-kind digit (산 -> 임야 2, else 토지 1) + 본번 + 부번. Prose lots do not assemble. Measured 2026-10-21: assemblable for 98.6% of 매각대상.

silver_load.$comment: What one Silver load may take (plan-silver-load-objects): objects of each search that no commit of its table records, landed within window_days, oldest first, at most max_objects per table (a week of nights). The window stays shorter than the snapshot retention (lakehouse-maintenance.contract.json retain_days, refused otherwise): an expired snapshot takes its load record with it.

pnu_resolution.$comment: ADR-0280 §4. The list rows carry no PNU. The 행정구역 names (hjguSido, hjguSigu, hjguDong, hjguRd) with the representative lot (daepyoLotno) are read as a jibun address, else rdNm with buldNo as a road address, through address_pnu.py with these 시도 prefixes (the registered-factory contract's, the same values).
